question.text: As per SEBI regulations, within how many working days of a redemption request must the mutual fund dispatch the redemption proceeds to the investor?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI regulations require redemption proceeds to be dispatched within 10 working days of the redemption request. For dividends, the pay-out must be made within 15 days of declaration. If the AMC fails to meet these timelines, it must pay the unitholder interest at 15% per annum, and this expense must be borne by the AMC and cannot be charged to the scheme. The Trap: The 15-day timeline relates to dividend pay-outs, not redemption proceeds. The 3-day option is also incorrect — 3 days is not the regulatory maximum for redemptions. Separately, the workbook says NFO units must be allotted within 5 business days, so even the NFO timeline is not 3 days. Note: The 15% per annum delay-interest obligation falls on the AMC, which gives AMCs a strong incentive to settle redemptions well within the 10-working-day cap.
